name: Boateng Advisory
description: Warm, editorial one-page site for a small Ghanaian business consulting firm in Accra: paper and clay palette, the founder's arched portrait with a handwritten note, a 'sound familiar' checklist, four priced services (ORC registration and compliance, business plans for loans and grants, tax/PAYE/SSNIT and bookkeeping, systems and staff training), a four-step process, anonymised results, testimonials, a founder letter with team, FAQ, and a WhatsApp-first consultation form that tags each enquiry by service.
